##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 04 October 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and high pressure to the south of the British Isles as various fronts affect the north and west.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 at times in central areas.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the north, decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening, veering north or northwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain.
